Ways to Vote

Early Voting

Early Voting in New York State

Your Early Vote Will Count

Early Voting is just like voting on Election Day. Early voters privately mark and scan their ballot. Early Voting results are counted, tabulated and included in (unofficial) election night totals.


Early Voting Locations

Voters may visit any of their assigned Early Voting Centers in their county, except in New York City, where voters are assigned to one early voting site.

Find YOUR Early Voting Polling Place


Early Voting Days and Times

For Primary, General, and Special elections, early voters are provided with nine days to vote in person prior to Election Day. Early Voting hours of operation are provided by local County Boards of Elections.

  • 2026 General Election Early Voting: October 24th through November 1st
